description: This Java class 'MonitoringReporter' handles reporting of latencies, service failures, and recoveries within the monitoring system of the application. It interacts with notification and telemetry services, manages latency data, and triggers notifications based on thresholds.

classes.name: MonitoringReporter
classes.description: Main class responsible for reporting latencies, handling service failure and recovery notifications, and interacting with telemetry and notification services.

methods.name: reportLatencies
methods.description: Reports collected latencies, sends high latency notifications if thresholds are exceeded, and reports latencies to telemetry.

methods.name: reportLatency
methods.description: Records a latency measurement for a given key.

methods.name: serviceFailure
methods.description: Handles a service failure event, increments failure count, and sends failure notifications based on thresholds.

methods.name: serviceIsOk
methods.description: Handles service recovery, resets failure count, and sends recovery notifications if needed.
